epic.title: My collection
epic.description: Screens E1–E2: Poke Genie import, what changed, and the collection list with league ranks and raid value.

features.title: Poke Genie import
tasks: CSV parser for the Poke Genie export (columns, number formats)
Match rows to species, forms and costumes; unmatched rows with reasons
Upload endpoint with size limits, format checks and background processing with progress
Library of real anonymised sample exports for tests

features.title: Re-upload and what changed
tasks: Diff: new, gone, powered up, evolved, new moves (match by family + IVs + catch date)
Import report and All changes screens

features.title: Collection list
tasks: List API: search, sort, quick filters (shiny, lucky, Shadow)
PvP rank per league judged as final evolution; chip only in the top 2% (98%)
Raid value: % of the best attacker of its type at real level and IVs; Mega-ready scored as Mega
Phone list, desktop table, legend and first-time upload state

features.title: Collection privacy and scale
tasks: Collections readable only by their owner; removed with the account
Load test: 5,000-row export imports within limits
